data_import.title: Data Import
data_import.subtitle: Upload a CSV or XLSX file of patient records or your hospital's facility data. Columns that match your existing fields are filled in automatically; anything else becomes a custom field for your hospital only — nothing is ever silently dropped.
data_import.entity_pick_hint: Picking a specific type here always skips both the mixed-dataset sorting AND the multi-table-file detection below — use this when you know exactly which table a file belongs to (e.g. a plain billing tariff export), especially if a "category"/"type" column in it isn't actually about people or table names and Auto-detect might misread it.
data_import.no_custom_fields: No custom fields registered yet for this data type — upload a file with columns outside your existing schema to create some.
data_import.search_patients: Search by name, phone, or UHID
data_import.mapping_summary: {count} rows found, {fieldCount} columns detected. Review the matches below, then confirm.
data_import.fields_redirected_note: {count} column(s) didn't fit the field they were mapped to and were saved as custom fields instead: {fields}.
data_import.uhid_collisions_note: {count} row(s) had a UHID/patient ID that was already in use — a new one was generated automatically and the file's original value was kept as a custom field.
data_import.doctor_links_unresolved_note: {count} patient(s) had a doctor name that didn't match any of your doctors — kept as a custom field instead of linking to the wrong one.
data_import.manual_mapping_hint: Review and adjust each column's match before importing.
data_import.auto_mapping_hint: The system will use its best match for every column automatically — nothing to review.
data_import.confirm_delete_patients_batch: Delete every patient this import created? This can't be undone — you'll need to re-upload the file to get this data back.
data_import.confirm_delete_hospital_batch: Undo this import? Your hospital's facility record will be restored to what it was right before this import ran.
data_import.confirm_delete_auto_batch: Delete every record this import created (patients, doctors, nurses, or any other staff)? This can't be undone — you'll need to re-upload the file to get this data back.
data_import.confirm_delete_selected_batches: Delete these {count} import(s) from your history? Any that were committed will have every row they created removed, exactly like deleting them one at a time — this can't be undone.
data_import.entity_auto: Auto-detect (mixed dataset — patients, doctors, nurses, etc. all in one file)
data_import.auto_entity_wrong_hint: Not right? Click Cancel below, then pick the correct type from "What are you importing?" and re-upload.
data_import.confirm_delete_multi_batch: Delete every row this import created, across every table it touched? The upload itself stays in your history and can be re-committed afterward if you fix and re-confirm its mapping.
data_import.confirm_discard_batch: Remove this incomplete/failed import from your history? Nothing was ever committed from it, so there's nothing to undo — this just clears the entry.
data_import.choose_unclassified_type_first: Pick a record type from "Import these as" above before clicking Assign.
data_import.auto_skipped_note: {count} row(s) skipped automatically ({breakdown}) — this data is already kept up to date automatically whenever the records that reference it are imported, so there's nothing to review for them.
data_import.delete_success_multi: {count} row(s) deleted across every table this import touched. It can be re-committed from the batch history if needed.
data_import.choose_folder_hint: Pick a folder and every CSV/XLSX file inside it is queued and imported one at a time — you still review each file's field matches (or sorted groups, for Auto-detect) before it commits, same as a single upload, just without re-choosing the file each time.
data_import.folder_no_importable: That folder has {count} file(s), but none are .csv/.xlsx/.xls.
data_import.folder_empty: That folder appears to be empty.
data_import.folder_queue_complete: Folder import complete — processed {done} of {total} file(s).
data_import.unclassified_hint: Couldn't confidently tell what these rows are.
data_import.confirm_skip_unclassified: Skip these rows? They will not be imported anywhere.
data_import.resolve_unclassified_first: Resolve the Unclassified group first — assign it to a record type or skip it.
data_import.import_stopped: Stopped — fix the issue below, then click Import All again.
data_import.staff_visible_note: Any doctors, nurses, or other staff imported are now visible on the Existing Staff page.
data_import.single_row_entity_warning: Your hospital only has ONE facility record — it isn't a list. This file has {count} rows, so importing it will overwrite that same record {count} times over, one after another, and only the LAST row will be kept; the other {countMinusOne} will be lost. If this file is really a list of many people or records, choose "Patient records" instead and re-upload.
data_import.confirm_single_row_entity: This will overwrite your hospital's one facility record {count} times and keep only the last row. Are you sure this file isn't meant to be a list of many patients/records?
